away.summary: The Golden Knights (5-2-0) are projected to start Adin Hill in goal after Carter Hart's recent appearance. They will be without injured forwards Victor Olofsson (lower body) and Parker Wotherspoon (upper body, week-to-week), and scratched defenseman Ville Heinola. The team is coming off a 4-2 loss to Minnesota and aims to maintain their strong early-season form under first-year head coach Ryan Craig.

home.summary: The Predators (2-1-2) are projected to start Juuse Saros in goal, with Matt Murray as backup. They will be without injured goaltender Justus Annunen (undisclosed, day-to-day) and forwards Mavrik Bourque (upper body, day-to-day) and William Trudeau (upper body), plus scratched defensemen Jack Ahcan and Ilya Lyubushkin. Nashville looks to improve on a slow start as they host Vegas in the first of a back-to-back set.
